content.summary: The note reviews capacity at the Bang Na warehouse for the 3 November Q4 launch: 8,160 of 9,600 pallet positions (85%) are in use, and a 20% rise in launch-week orders would fill Zone A by 28 October. It recommends moving slow-moving Zone B stock to a partner cross-dock now and renting the Samut Prakan overflow space only if pre-orders pass 18,000 on 23 October.
key_points: Zone A is full by 28 October if orders grow 20%
The cross-dock frees 500 positions for 85,000 THB a month
Rent the overflow space only if pre-orders pass 18,000

content.summary: The cross-dock trial moved 480 pallet positions of slow-moving Zone B stock to the partner warehouse in Lat Krabang during the week of 13 October, at 85,000 THB for the week. Zone B is now 68% full and Zone A is still 92% full.
key_points: Handling cost 85,000 THB for the week
Zone B is 68% full, Zone A 92% full
Confirm the partner's second dock slot by Friday
